patthana22.17:1.1: na sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana22.17:2.1: na dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana22.17:3.1: na adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana22.17:4.1: na sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ na hetuñca na adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ na hetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. dutiyaṃ gaṇitakena tīṇi. hetuyā ekavīsa.
patthana22.17:5.1: na sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ na nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: dve.
patthana22.17:6.1: na dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ na nahetuṃ .. dve pañhāyeva.
patthana22.17:7.1: na adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ na nahetuṃ .. dveyeva. paṭhamaṃ gaṇitakena ekaṃ. dutiyaṃ gaṇitakena ekaṃ. tatiyaṃ gaṇitakena ekaṃ. hetuyā nava. navipākattika nahetuduke vipākattika hetudukaṃ
